title: Override policy
text: Agent or user may override a gate, each with a written reason (--override GATE="reason" --by <who>); every override is a line in overrides.jsonl and must be named in the handover (decided by the user 2026-11-25).
confirm: Which gates were overridden, by whom and why, and are they named in the handover?
probe: agent or user, each with a written reason
